text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, look at the time. Guess it's about time to head to the track~."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I mean, wanna grab food together after training today?
I heard the family restaurant nearby added a secret menu item~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really? I'm in, I'm in!
Oh, what about Furioso-chan? Wanna come along?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
......
......Yes, I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh!? What an unexpected reply! Usually, you'd
turn it down saying 'I won't be swayed~!' at times like this.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...It's just that cooking every day is a hassle,
so I thought eating out today wouldn't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I see. You live on your own after all.
Wanna skip out on chores once in a while, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm gonna hit up the drink bar.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Well then,
Doktor Sugar, if you please~.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Who said I was gonna
bring yours too! Don't mess with me!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Here ya go! Furioso,
yours is carrot juice!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
You really saved me.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (They brought it for me after all...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hey, Furioso-chan.
That doria looks pretty tasty, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Would you like a bite?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I was actually torn
about getting that one too... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! I'll share mine with you too, okay? Hold on while I whip up a mini-carbonara on a small plate for you~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, that secret menu was even better than the rumors.
The family restaurant staff meals are pretty tasty too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway, sorry about this. That shop
is in the complete opposite direction of Julio's apartment,
so it ended up being quite a detour."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine.
I'm the one who accepted the invitation, after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh, I see.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I've been meaning to ask you. How's living alone? Total freedom and awesome?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "...It offers freedom, yes, but I wouldn't call it the best. Cleaning and laundry can be a real hassle at times, after all—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Cooking for oneself is especially tough, isn't it? There are days like today where you eat out, or end up relying on a bento...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see~. So it's not all fun and games.
Cooking alone, eating alone...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, oh yeah. You always eat meals
alone, right? Don't you get lonely?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: No. Not really.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
“......Aha. I see now. The reason Furio
tagged along with us this time was—”

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, Tran. We're going to eat with
this same group again. No complaints, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind, but... hehe.
Is this for Furioso?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah?! As if, you idiot!
Next time I'm definitely finishing that jumbo parfait!!
...That's why, moron!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah.
Let's just go with that, then."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One night. I spotted Furioso looking rather cheerful.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Actually, I just finished eating a meal with my classmates a moment ago.
choice_data_list: Ah, that's why your steps were so light.
Did you eat plenty and build up your stamina?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh... Was it?
choice_data_list: Yeah. It really sounds like it was a fun party!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, truly.
It's lively, and so cozy...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'd love to go again if there's a chance.
—Fufu."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Regarding dessert... Tran-san egged her on,
so Espo-san ended up ordering way too much...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Eating it together with Hishi Miracle-san……
hehe, it was really fun."
choice_data_list: Hm? Don't you mean 'it was delicious'?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —It was fun. Very much so.
